description: Create a named LAYER, STYLE (text/font), LTYPE (simple dash pattern), or DIMSTYLE in a native AC1032 DWG. Copies the drawing's default entry and applies validated properties atomically. Read cad.describe_type for property names/types. Use font_name for STYLE; dashes for LTYPE; dimtxt/dimasz/dimdec for DIMSTYLE; color/linetype_handle/lineweight_index for LAYER. References are hex handles returned by creation/query tools. Returns the new handle. Symbols can then be assigned by name in cad.add_entities. Existing names are refused. Font files must be available to the renderer/CAD application; setting font_name does not install a font.
name: cad.create_symbol
